Orb of Alchemy
Stackable Currency
Stack Size: 1 / 20
Upgrades a Normal or Magic item to a Rare item with 4 random modifiers
Right click this item then left click a normal or magic item to apply it. Current modifiers are not retained. Shift click to unstack.
